_comment: Edit these to change what the finder looks for. Re-run after editing.
_siteUrl: Public URL where the report is hosted (e.g. https://rentals.example.com/listings.html). Only used for SEO/GEO tags (canonical, Open Graph, JSON-LD @id). Leave empty when browsing the file locally.
_maxPriceWithUtilities: Higher cap allowed when utilities are included in the rent (base maxPrice applies otherwise).
_minArea: Skip apartments smaller than this (m²). Lowered to 20 when 1-room flats were added — most Rīga studios are 20-30 m², so a 30 m² floor would have hidden nearly all of them.
_excludeFirstFloor: Skip ground/1st-floor apartments (floor 1). Listings with unknown floor are kept.
_renovatedPriority: Sort renovated / new listings to the top.
_excludeOld: Drop listings clearly flagged as needing repair / run-down. Unknown condition is kept.
_requireRenovated: Set true to keep ONLY listings confirmed renovated/new (hides unknowns too).
_utilitiesPriority: true = sort utilities-included listings to the top (does NOT hide the others). Set requireUtilitiesIncluded=true to hide non-inclusive ones entirely.

sslv._note: 'all' = every Rīga district (the district is read from each ad's link). Use a district slug like 'centre' to narrow again. Paging stops automatically at the last page.

city24._note: Empty list = every Rīga district. Add names like ["Centrs", "Vecrīga"] to narrow.

pplv._note: 3811 = apartments. Region ids are pp.lv Rīga districts (801 Avoti · 807 Brasa · 811 Centrs · 813 Dārzciems · 834 Pētersala-Andrejsala · 837 Purvciems · 846 Teika). Each returns its ~20 newest rentals; pp.lv exposes no deeper paging.

varianti._note: varianti.lv JSON API (also the data behind cityreal.lv). Empty districts = the whole of Rīga; ids from POST api.varianti.lv/rest/address/district (1 = Centrs) to narrow.

latio._note: latio.lv, server-rendered HTML. Empty places = whole country scanned, Rīga kept; use location option ids from latio.lv/lv/ipasumi (7533 = Centrs) to narrow. Latio publishes no posting dates.

arcoreal._note: arcoreal.lv, server-rendered HTML. 'visas-vietas' = all of Rīga; district slugs like 'centrs' narrow it. Card data only: one photo, no dates.

geocode._note: Nominatim (OpenStreetMap) fills in coordinates for the map when a source doesn't publish them. Cached forever in state/geocache.json; at most maxPerRun new addresses per run, 1 request/second, per the Nominatim usage policy. Data © OpenStreetMap contributors.

_deepCheckUtilities: Fetch each surviving ss.lv listing page for the exact date, the full text (utilities/condition/furnishing) and the COMPLETE photo gallery. Turn it off, or pass --fast, for a quicker but shallower run.

dedupe._threshold: How much evidence is needed before two posts are treated as the same flat. Higher = more cautious (more duplicates survive); lower = more aggressive (risks merging two different flats). 4.0 was calibrated against hand-checked pairs — see lib/dedupe.js.
dedupe._areaTolerance: Two posts of one flat may quote areas this far apart (m²) — sites round differently.
dedupe._geoMetres: Coordinates this close count as the same building (city24 publishes lat/lon; the other two do not).
dedupe._maxPriceRatio: Above this price ratio, the gap counts as evidence the posts are NOT the same flat.

_politeness: requestDelayMs is the pause between requests to the same site, concurrency the number in flight. These sites are free and public — do not raise them much.
